Cross-device continuity cursor: which entity this person was last on. Session-only by construction — a shared API key has no single 'last-viewed' entity — so there is nothing here an API consumer could call. Web and desktop are the only clients. NOTE: this route was mounted but UNREACHABLE while its package was missing from route-reachability.json: with no generated capability, routeauth refused it (403 route_authorization_unclassified) and the API would not boot at all without POSTWAVE_SKIP_ROUTE_AUTHZ_VALIDATION=1. The parity guard could not see it, so nothing reported the gap. The classification exists now because registering the package surfaced it.

Single-use action links. Unauthenticated because the ticket is the credential — the surface exists precisely to act from an email, chat message or lock screen where no session exists. GET previews and consumes nothing, because mail clients and security scanners prefetch links and a redeeming GET would approve things nobody clicked; POST performs and carries the ticket in the body so the secret stays out of access logs and Referer headers. Every rejection returns one indistinguishable answer so the endpoint cannot be used to probe for valid secrets, and redemption authorises one named action on one resource and never creates a session.

A browser redirect carried in email bodies, not an SDK operation — nothing generates a client for it, so it sits outside the OpenAPI contract like the other /api/public browser surfaces. Public and anonymous by design: the recipient arriving here has no session, which is the entire point, because this is the reader who never clicked. Every miss — unknown slug, retired path, malformed slug, a destination host that lost verification, and any internal fault — returns one indistinguishable 404, so an anonymous caller cannot use it to enumerate which campaigns a workspace is running. The redirect target is built from a host already verified for the workspace rather than from anything in the request, so the route cannot be turned into an open redirect.
